g.text: 1,000 candidates · 193 features · GPT-6 Astra, max reasoning · 3 agent seeds · 100 total evaluations per run
Curves and markers: arithmetic means. Shading/error bars: sample standard deviation (ddof=1), not confidence intervals; lower limits clipped at zero.
Agent n=3; each baseline n=10. MOF baselines use calls 1–100 of the supplied 110-call traces, including all ten initialization calls. Regret = full-pool maximum − best observed score.
Decision boundaries are prospective evaluator snapshots; parentheses give block call counts. Exact labels, settings and rationale are preserved in the per-seed reports.
Log display only: zero values and clipped band endpoints are drawn at 1e-08.
